# Layout of the fake dotnet folder used by the tests.
# sdk <version> <runtime>   creates sdk/<version>/dotnet.runtimeconfig.json
# dir <path>                creates an empty folder
#
# 10.0.303 came with runtime 10.0.11, which was removed later: it runs on
# 10.0.15 now. 8.0.22 is a runtime installed without an SDK, and
# fixtures/state/runtimes says 8.0.34 was installed with 'dvm install runtime'.
# Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App is what a Windows folder has; elsewhere it is
# just one more framework folder.
sdk 10.0.404 10.0.15
sdk 10.0.303 10.0.11
sdk 10.0.110 10.0.10
sdk 8.0.428 8.0.34
dir shared/Microsoft.NETCore.App/10.0.15
dir shared/Microsoft.NETCore.App/10.0.10
dir shared/Microsoft.NETCore.App/8.0.34
dir shared/Microsoft.NETCore.App/8.0.22
dir shared/Microsoft.AspNetCore.App/10.0.15
dir shared/Microsoft.AspNetCore.App/10.0.10
dir shared/Microsoft.AspNetCore.App/8.0.34
dir shared/Microsoft.AspNetCore.App/8.0.22
dir shared/Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App/10.0.15
dir shared/Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App/10.0.10
dir shared/Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App/8.0.34
dir shared/Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App/8.0.22
dir packs/Microsoft.NETCore.App.Ref/10.0.15
dir packs/Microsoft.NETCore.App.Ref/10.0.11
dir packs/Microsoft.NETCore.App.Ref/10.0.10
dir packs/Microsoft.NETCore.App.Ref/8.0.34
dir packs/NETStandard.Library.Ref/2.1.0
dir host/fxr/10.0.15
dir host/fxr/10.0.10
dir host/fxr/8.0.34
dir host/fxr/8.0.22
dir templates/10.0.15
dir templates/10.0.11
dir templates/10.0.10
dir templates/8.0.34
dir sdk-manifests/10.0.100
dir sdk-manifests/10.0.300
dir sdk-manifests/10.0.400
dir sdk-manifests/8.0.400
